title: Complementary McCarthy inequality beyond the known parameter ranges
statement:
Let $A$ and $B$ be positive operators and let $q\in\mathbb{R}$. **Complementary McCarthy conjecture.**

$$
\operatorname{Tr}(A+B)^q\leq \operatorname{Tr}A^q+\operatorname{Tr}B^q+(2^q-2)\operatorname{Tr}(A^{1/2}BA^{1/2})^{q/2}
$$

for $-2<q<0$, while the reversed inequality should hold for $3\leq q$. The displayed ranges complement the theorem known for $q\leq-2$ and $1\leq q\leq2$; numerical simulations support the conjecture, but the source gives no resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1201.5232

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2012).
source_name: K. M. R. Audenaert and F. Kittaneh, “Problems and Conjectures in Matrix and Operator Inequalities”, arXiv:1201.5232 (2012).
